meta.name: popups
meta.description: When the user wants to create or optimize popups, modals, overlays, slide-ins, or banners for conversion purposes. Also use when the user mentions "exit intent," "popup conversions," "modal optimization," "lead capture popup," "email popup," "announcement banner," "overlay," "collect emails with a popup," "exit popup," "scroll trigger," "sticky bar," or "notification bar." Use this for any overlay or interrupt-style conversion element. For forms outside of popups, see cro. For general page conversion optimization, see cro.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并优化提升转化的弹窗与横幅
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想用弹窗收集邮箱或提升页面转化。
copy.tagline_en: Create and optimize high-converting popups, modals, and banners
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to capture leads and boost conversions with popups

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成弹窗设计顾问：先问你想要弹窗达到什么目的（如收集邮箱、促销），然后给出建议，包括什么时候出现、写什么内容、多久弹一次，并提醒注意隐私规则，最后给出可测试的方案。
howto.when: 当你想创建或优化弹窗、模态框等转化元素，或提到“exit intent”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我网站访客要走时弹什么好？帮我设计一个退出弹窗
say.note: Claude 会询问目标并给出方案

say.text: 帮我优化邮件订阅弹窗的文案和触发时机
say.note: Claude 会按最佳实践给出建议

say.text: 我的弹窗在手机上体验差，怎么改进？
say.note: Claude 会针对移动端给出设计调整

howto.what_en: After install, Claude acts as a popup optimization consultant, asking about your goal, current performance, and traffic, then gives a design covering trigger, type, copy, frequency, compliance, and test ideas.
howto.when_en: When you want to create or optimize popups, modals, banners, or other conversion elements, or when you mention keywords like 'exit intent' or 'popup conversions'.

say_en.text: What should I show when visitors are about to leave? Design an exit popup.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about goals and provide a plan.

say_en.text: Help me optimize the copy and trigger timing of my email signup popup.
My popup works badly on mobile. How can I improve it?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest mobile-specific design changes.
